capabilities: Chat with the vault using retrieval over your notes
Edit, rewrite, and complete text inline with Quick Ask and Tab completion
Run agents that call tools, MCP servers, skills, and desktop Bash
Reuse locally signed-in CLI agents such as Claude Code and Codex
Build flashcards and FSRS-based review from topics and source material
extras: Full user documentation lives in a separate documentation folder. The README warns that YOLO cannot coexist with Smart Composer and must replace it. It can also work via ChatGPT/Gemini OAuth instead of API keys, and local embedding models allow knowledge-base indexing without any API key. Development is sponsored by Kilo Code.
